headline: Portable Projector and dual displays transform dorm rooms
summary: The NEBULA Mars 3 Air projector offers Google TV and a 150-inch screen, while laptop screen extenders add up to two extra displays for $180.
details: Dorm rooms are notoriously small, forcing students to make compromises. However, entertainment and productivity don't have to suffer thanks to innovative gadgets.

The NEBULA Mars 3 Air is a portable smart projector featuring Google TV for access to streaming services and apps. It projects a sharp 1080p image up to 150 inches and boasts a 400-ANSI-lumen rating, performing best in darker environments.

A key feature of the NEBULA Mars 3 Air is its built-in battery, offering up to 2.5 hours of video playback or 8 hours of music, eliminating the need for constant power. This makes it ideal for flexible use around a dorm room.

For productivity, laptop screen extenders can significantly boost multitasking capabilities. These devices allow users to add up to two extra screens, expanding screen real estate without consuming much desk space.

These versatile laptop screen extenders are compatible with Windows, macOS, and ChromeOS, offering a flexible solution for students needing more display options. They are currently available for $180.
These tools can help students create a cinema experience or a more efficient study station within the confines of a small dorm room, offering practical solutions for space limitations.
